result.keyword: What's the best payment processor for a small online store?
result.markdown:
For most small online stores, **Stripe is the best all-around payment processor**\. However, if you're using Shopify, I'd recommend **Shopify Payments** instead.

The best choice depends on your e-commerce platform, transaction volume, and how you want customers to pay.

## My top 5 recommendations

![Vagus Nerve Certification | MindMax Academy](https://images.openai.com/static-rsc-4/aXMVm1C0IZ2sYL1Cc-pnLa0-TAY84r1ttAkC3L-BonUW-0ZWt4YgfYxZJFNFO507YDw7sEw0_m36oWUAFe9k5k5U7mabcFJnFcYfX_JEQIwvZxSSTzYlrpiE9fNs0cFfLq2VqBOGktLoGahF64GIPKHvKbJJ1Jz0L_56eTNx-TPu4D5oHHq8-DAX5xxs05i8?purpose=fullsize)

**1\. Stripe**

(Best overall)

- Typical US online card fee: 2.9% + \$0.30
- No standard monthly processing fee
- Excellent integrations and fraud prevention
- Supports subscriptions and international payments

Best for independent online stores using WooCommerce, Wix, or custom websites.

[Stripe pricing](https://stripe.com/pricing)

---

![Shopify Payments w Polsce – jak działa, koszty, wdrożenie, zalety - Adtrip](https://images.openai.com/static-rsc-4/tzlxg0Y9z5dRoMa7puRQ5gUF-G3hcQ7FEcuVco38BEG917LKXepufVl9cw-FwTKDdqoHqkcHNs202c43Bsg-KXxlvnrYPNEJMBSIYJqLREQ2DlgIvAOQgkKyUCOU_zdRd59gIwC2e-5cs0YCLvv_6mYa-9FiK4qFkvvkawoheALPlNv3AkWQkvUMElw-UVk8?purpose=fullsize)

**2\. Shopify Payments**

(Best for Shopify stores)

- Rates depend on your Shopify plan
- Integrated directly into Shopify
- Simplifies refunds, orders, and payouts
- Avoids additional Shopify third-party transaction fees

Best if your store is already built on Shopify.

[Shopify Payments](https://www.shopify.com/payments)

---

![Download the PayPal logo in PNG y SVG | LogosDown](https://images.openai.com/static-rsc-4/MAzkiJ1YuDnyj2FyYAyszlEHA_k7S0XqFuDRhbVDc0cICTj1-X82VJgt7N8vcRcKsONlo3HvF0Pe2MUizAJnEXGjXwhkQKSdT9w8dASkeKU2hONBc_K0UGh46cKL9ey1QEsmTJtnMOjwtp9k8flMfotUdye-2o09Vcb_X37Fr_RqbfMx2vNQ-Z2QRLli3zQI?purpose=fullsize)

**3\. PayPal**

(Best for customer trust)

- Familiar checkout experience
- Accepts PayPal and other payment methods
- Easy to integrate
- Fees can be higher than Stripe

Best as an additional checkout option.

[PayPal Checkout](https://www.paypal.com/business/accept-payments/checkout)

---

![Square, Inc Logo PNG,  Vector (AI, EPS, CDR, PDF, SVG) - iconLogoVector](https://images.openai.com/static-rsc-4/o-iRI2kybznmyDubdZ44gVK-vjE6gDKLVakQnJxlACGxko3Nj1jIpWaBRdIuWDcPvStz6IZe1O-k-UExmpEW7lDQ_S559qV-l4JT0xhrWDjCbTjdZDVgBDFR6LW32FKPeauHAWGYSuEdhn0AMiHDAZFaPUNLlmIzwiGcOc7OZzuhVnlNs80uSa8gb9GbKVsf?purpose=fullsize)

**4\. Square**

- Online and in-person payments
- Inventory and point-of-sale tools
- Free starting plan
- Good for businesses with physical and online sales

Best for stores selling both online and in person.

[Square payments](https://squareup.com/us/en/payments)

---

![Top five fintech news stories of the week: 28 August 2026](https://images.openai.com/static-rsc-4/Nvwm5m0AvFIyEQCoAUiuiBYsES5Z_TGIIL3a7sg7Vv4eL9Itvfc5xa-EyPsr8IsSKHecG5NYexO0SMIejzwZMML07_ctHuEIL4ButxRVQGAmBUqOEkJLjZgpEozhbgzBigkUW3PNM8qwMbcubKNhZeml3Fh_1lYV5P7aYAnQGGfgg1x4XdQzyp-dffUe_NGw?purpose=fullsize)

**5\. Helcim**

- Interchange-plus pricing
- No standard monthly fee
- Potential savings as transaction volume grows
- More involved pricing structure

Best for growing stores processing larger payment volumes.

[Helcim pricing](https://www.helcim.com/pricing/)

These comparisons are based on published US pricing and provider features; actual rates vary by transaction type and eligibility. |--------|--------|
| Just starting an online store | Stripe |
| Using Shopify | Shopify Payments |
